discrete_triality: Lepton family charge +1 for L and -1 for ec, N=-1,H=+1. Ordinary untwisted global product with the original Z12 and the auxiliary Z3 in the UV. The four J have auxiliary charge +1. Flavons and B are inert under lepton protection.
dirac_positive: Z5 subgroup of integer 3(B−L), charges Q=1, uc=dc=-1, L=-3, ec=3. Reassign three existing J to parity-even right neutrinos with charge 3. Fourth remains an odd neutral singlet. Heavy N,H now have conserving opposite charges, +3 and -3. Old colored spectators neutral under the new group. No extra matter vs 1693. Canonical direct Yukawa branch suppresses JH and active N ports, and excludes an independent Weinberg contact by the exact group.
